category.reason: The target requires comparing the apartment’s bedroom count and dwelling type with the capacity descriptions of the moving trucks.

instruction.en: I need to move from a three-bedroom apartment. Select the most suitable moving truck.
instruction.zh: 我需要搬家，我的公寓有 3 间卧室，请选择最合适的搬家车辆。
